children: Reddy will assume the top role on 1 April 2027, subject to IRDAI approval, while incumbent Tapan Singhel will continue until 31 March

Bajaj General Insurance, formerly known as Bajaj Allianz General Insurance, has announced the appointment of Deepak Reddy as CEO-designate, effective 1 January 2027. He is scheduled to assume the role oSingheling Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD and CEO) on 1 April 2027, subject to approval from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI).
The company, an unlisted subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv, said incumbent MD and CEO Tapan Singhel will continue in his position until 31 March 2027 to ensure a smooth leadership transition.
Leadership Transition At Bajaj General Insurance

The appointment comes as the company prepares for its next phase of growth in India's general insurance sector.Sanjiv Bajaj, Chairman and Managing Director, Bajaj Finserv, acknowledged Singhel's contribution to the company's development, highlighting its underwriting discipline, innovation and customer-focused approach under his leadership.
Bajaj said Singhel's legacy extended beyond business performance to the development of an institution positioned for long-term growth.

Commenting on the sector's outlook, Bajaj highlighted opportunities to expand insurance protection across individuals, livelihoods and businesses as India's insurance industry enters its next phase of development.He expressed confidence in Reddy's ability to lead Bajaj General Insurance through its next chapter.
The planned transition will see Singhel remain at the helm until the end of March 2027, with Reddy expected to take over the following day, subject to regulatory clearance.
